ensemble_policy.method: seeded causal input-perturbation ensemble, not latent samples
ensemble_policy.mean_policy: Equal-weight physical basin and fixed-issue regional grids; member-mean coordinates and central pressures separately. Moving-core grids are not directly averaged.

wind_estimation_by_lead.aggregation: diagnose each member, then equal-weight mean; never diagnose the mean pressure

assumptions.wind_averaging_period: not calibrated to an agency averaging period
assumptions.calibration: none; fixed physical assumptions, not fitted to benchmarks
